note: Art packet for the intro diorama. Every layer is a GPT image render (1536x1024) against the listed references; cutout layers were rendered on pure white and processed with tools/cutout.py.

layers.prompt: Backdrop layer for a layered paper-theatre story diorama. Match the paper-cutout look and palette of the hero sheet (hand-painted illustration on aged cardstock, visible fibres) and the moonlit mood of the title art. Wide night landscape filling the entire image, flat front view: deep midnight-blue starry sky, large softly glowing full moon in the upper right third, layered scissor-cut paper clouds, rolling slate-blue hills and distant mountains of torn-paper strips, a small dark palace with thin spires on a far right hill under the moon, calm darker blue-green meadow in the lower 35%, faint warm glow on the left horizon. No characters, text, frame, border or vignette; even neutral lighting.

Midground layer: one wide continuous paper cutout of a small cosy village at night on plain pure white, in the backdrop's paper style, content from stage-1: timber-and-stone cottage with red tiled roof and chimney, stone windmill, small round stone tower, round leafy trees, long wooden rail fence along the front with carved runes that are dark and dull (wards broken), one fence section slightly broken, warm glowing windows. Thin cream scissor-cut border around the whole silhouette; no characters, text or ground shadow.
layers.retouch: Removed a cross finial from the cottage roof peak and rebuilt the cream border there (religious symbols are out of scope per ART-BIBLE).
